table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Selected='Y',
	EMP_Employee.FullName,   
	EMP_Employee.EmpID,   
	EMP_Employee.EmpCode,   
	EMP_Employee.Gender,   
	EMP_Employee.MaritalStatus,   
	EMP_Employee.Date,   
	EMP_Employee.BirthDate,   
	EMP_Employee.JoinDate,   
	Category = (SELECT EC.Name FROM EMP_Category EC WHERE EC.EmpCatCode=EMP_Employee.EmpCatCode),   
	Department = (SELECT D.Name FROM EMP_Department D WHERE D.DeptCode=EMP_Employee.DeptCode),   
	Designation = (SELECT D.Name FROM EMP_Designation D WHERE D.DesigCode=EMP_Employee.DesigCode),   
	AccountName = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=EMP_Employee.AccCode),   
	EMP_Employee.CNICNo,   
	EMP_Employee.FHName,   
	EMP_Employee.FHNICNo,   
	EMP_Employee.PMTAddress,   
	EMP_Employee.TmpAddress,   
	EMP_Employee.MobileNo,   
	EMP_Employee.PhoneNo,   
	EMP_Employee.Email,   
	EMP_Employee.Web,   
	EMP_Employee.Nationality,   
	EMP_Employee.Domicile,   
	EMP_Employee.Religion,   
	EMP_Employee.NTN,   
	EMP_Employee.BloodGroup,   
	EMP_Employee.ExitDate,   
	EMP_Employee.ExitReason,   
	EMP_Employee.RefferedBy  
FROM 
	EMP_Employee
